title: Construction of clay-mediated nZVI composites to alleviate the decline in Cr(VI) removal during co-transport with humic acid and phosphate
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00185D, Paper
Wenxin Jiang, Nan Xu, Wu Sun, Feng Du
The natural presence of phosphate and humic acid (HA) may have distinct impacts on the removal of Cr(VI) by green-synthesized nano-zero-valent iron (nZVI@GT) composites supported on various types of clays.
